description:
Which models Ollama has pulled on this machine, with size, parameters and quantisation. Which are loaded now and with what context. How much of each sits in video memory, and whether each pulled model would fit.
Use it before choosing a model or a context length. It knows nothing about past calls. For those use diagnose_my_turns or read_my_last_turn.
Returns text. A machine line (GPU, video memory, RAM) when LLMxRay is running, then "N models pulled:" and one line per model, sorted by name, ending in LOADED now, fits in VRAM, or larger than VRAM.
Takes no arguments, no model name and no filter. Needs Ollama reachable. Under a second, two listing calls. No model is loaded. The answer is a snapshot: a loaded model unloads after its keep_alive, so call it right before deciding.
name: list_local_models
title: List local models
